attributes.probed_form:
KEPT (real 28 -> 24, words 14 -> 12). The slot-4 dispatch
    register void (*decode)(u8*, u8*, s32) =
        *(void (**)(u8*, u8*, s32))(*(u32*)(movie + offsetof(MovieState, decoderVtable)) + 0x18);
    decode(movie + 0x150, movie + 0x11C, 0);
became `MovieCodecV4(movie + 0x150, movie + 0x11C, 0);` where MovieCodecV4 is a `static inline` C++ helper (`((MovieCodec*)codec)->v4(call, flags);`) declared in the cplusplus-on region. The DIRECT form -- moving fn_800DA6A4 itself into the cplusplus-on region as extern "C" -- was measured and DISCARDED: it is 160 instructions against the target's 159, because in C++ `return *(u32*)(movie+frameIndex) < *(u32*)(movie+...)` is a bool and MWCC adds `clrlwi r3,r0,24` at +0x20c. A `? TRUE : FALSE` respelling of the same return was worse (161 insns, `li r3,1` / `b` / `li r3,0`).

THREE NEUTRAL PROBES on the r27/r28 exchange, all at real 24, insns 159/159:
  (A) declaration order: `u8 unused[24]; register MovieAudioState* audio; u32 frame; register u32* chunk;` -> `u8 unused[24]; register u32* chunk; u32 frame; register MovieAudioState* audio;`
  (B) register qualifier: `register MovieAudioState* audio;` -> `MovieAudioState* audio;`
  (C) local-group membership: the block-scoped `s32 tag = gMovieAllocCount++;` hoisted to a function-scope `register s32 tag;` declared before `audio`, with the two uses left as plain assignments.
All three reverted; the file is back to the kept dispatch form only.
